description: “I just feel like including medical debt and credit reports is like kicking people when they're already down,” said Rep. Naquetta Ricks, D-Aurora, one of the law’s co-sponsors. “The long term impacts can be traumatic.”

title: Colorado’s AG, Democratic lawmakers criticize Trump administration move to include medical debt in people’s credit reports — State Representative Naquetta Ricks HD40
